therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: bispecific T-cell engager (BiTE) bridging BCMA-expressing myeloma cells to CD3+ T cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma who are refractory to at least one proteasome inhibitor, one immunomodulatory drug, and one anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody (triple-class refractory)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR) per IMWG criteria

results.target_engagement_evidence: Serum elranatamab concentrations measured at C4D1 and C7D1 (total and free); Cohort A geometric mean total: 31100 ng/mL (C4D1), 37960 ng/mL (C7D1); Cohort B: 22840 ng/mL (C4D1), 29880 ng/mL (C7D1)
biomarker_changes: Total elranatamab concentration (C4D1): Cohort A 31100 ng/mL, Cohort B 22840 ng/mL
Total elranatamab concentration (C7D1): Cohort A 37960 ng/mL, Cohort B 29880 ng/mL
Free elranatamab concentration (C4D1): Cohort A 19090 ng/mL, Cohort B 16170 ng/mL
Free elranatamab concentration (C7D1): Cohort A 32830 ng/mL, Cohort B 29880 ng/mL
MRD negativity rate assessed per IMWG sequencing criteria in CR/sCR patients
subgroup_findings: Cohort A ORR in participants with extramedullary disease (EMD) at baseline: 38.5% (95% CI: 23.4–55.4)
Cohort A ORR in participants without EMD at baseline: 71.4% (95% CI: 60.5–80.8)
safety_signals: Cytokine release syndrome (CRS) reported and graded per ASTCT criteria
Immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) reported and graded per ASTCT criteria

Serious adverse events including anemia, febrile neutropenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, aplasia pure red cell, atrial fibrillation, cardio-respiratory arrest, angina pectoris, cardiac failure acute, cardiogenic shock, and cardiac shock

context.indication: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (triple-class refractory: refractory to at least one PI, one IMiD, and one anti-CD38 mAb)
